title: Blue Archive Plushies
description: Adds Blue Archive plushies as model replacement for totem of undying
body:
This resource pack now has support for Optifine CIT in versions 1.12 to 1.21.3.
For mod packs without Optifine, there is a mod for Forge called Forge CIT and for Fabric called CIT Resewn. (With version 1.21.5+, this resource pack is completely vanilla, requiring no mods)

Current models included:
- Takanashi Hoshino
- Rikuhachima Aru
- Igusa Haruka
- Onikata Kayoko
- Asagi Mutsuki
- Okusora Ayane
- Izayoi Nonomi
- Kuromi Serika
- Sunaookami Shiroko
- Ushio Noa
- Kurosaki Koyuki
- Tsukatsuki Rio
- Hayase Yuuka

Variants:
- Hoshino Homeless
- Aru Shocked
- Okusora Ayane 2 (version without glasses)
- Frozen Koyuki
- Hayase Motors (version with cap)

New:
- Sorasaki Hina
- Amau Ako
- Shiromi Iori
- Hinomiya Chinatsu

Variants:
- Beena

Misc:
- Omi Omi Box (rename a stick)
- Burger Set (rename a bread)

**How to use:**
Rename the Totem of Undying on an anvil to one of the names listed above.

For models sitting on item frames, add an "F" at the end of the name.
(This is the solution we found to avoid glitches in the totem:use animation model caused by resizing/positioning on item frames, since they rely on the same setting)

Example: "Hoshino F"

This project is still in progress. We'll add more plushies very soon.🔥
